_source: Tiecke, Properties of Potassium (Table 9); Falke et al., PRA 74, 032503 (2006). Ground A from Arimondo/Beckmann (Allegrini Recommended).
_isotope: K-39 (I=3/2, 93.26% natural abundance = the hyperfine.py default)
_gI_source: Atomic g_I′ (μ_B units, Steck sign convention; measured in the atom, so it includes diamagnetic shielding): Arimondo, Inguscio & Violino, Rev. Mod. Phys. 49, 31 (1977), as tabulated in Steck and ElecSus (arXiv:1409.1873, Table B). Ground g_J: Vanden Bout et al., Phys. Rev. 165, 88 (1968).
_note: K-41 constants are under _K41_D_line (use --isotope 41). Other isotopes: A is rescaled from this block by g_I and B by Q (hyperfine anomaly neglected) with a printed warning. Allegrini notes a split in 4p1/2 literature (~27.78 vs ~28.85 MHz); Falke/Tiecke 27.775 is used here.

_K41_D_line._source: Tiecke, Properties of Potassium Table 9; Falke et al. PRA 74, 032503 (2006); Allegrini et al. 2022 Sec. 4.3.2
